packageRules.description: A workspace-wide major lands as one PR with a dozen or more majors in it (TypeScript, eslint, vitest, antd, msw and others at once), and a closed group PR is recreated at once. Majors are taken by hand, one package at a time.
ace-builds 1.45 stops the YAML worker requesting buffer.js and reports errors a row early, which breaks yamlWorkerShim. Held until the shim is reviewed against it.
